title: Particle laws · Lorenz, Galton, a parabolic mirror and a fire front
description: The GPU engine's motion laws, mirror volume and ignition rule (src/fight-particles.ts, docs/graphics.md § Fight particles on the GPU), as the effects lab shows them bare (src/law-lab.ts, just dev-fx): streams of four colours caught by the Lorenz field until ρ falls from 28 to 0.5 and it collapses into its origin; a Galton board whose ghost balls draw a bell while three of gold fall where their paths say; sparks raining along a paraboloid's axis that reflect through its focus and draw the caustic; a front of fire crossing a cloud of gas; bubbles rising fast through contained water and drifting once out of it. Played in a real fight, captured at twice the pixels (--gpu --scale 2) on the game's clock at 30 fps.

steps.caption: Lorenz: motes strung along an orbit keep to both lobes while streams of four colours are caught by the field and woven in; at 3.4 s ρ falls from 28 to 0.5 in 0.8 s and the whole attractor spirals into its origin, a flash where it ends
Galton board: ghost balls on random paths fill a bell; three gold balls fall into bins 3, 4 and 6 as their paths say
Parabolic mirror: sparks falling along its axis (5° off) reflect through the focus and draw the caustic
Ignition: a cloud of gas lit at its left end; the front of fire runs through it
Bubbles in contained water: fast through it, drifting once out
